data.title: 风格与摄影验收
data.prompt:
cinematic realism, natural light, high-end commercial photography, refined color grading
Kodak film look, warm highlights, soft grain, rich analog color
保持参考图小图形的角色特征和蓝色围巾，坐在温暖的森林空地中，单张完整画面。
Render the final image as a photograph captured using ARRI ALEXA 35 paired with a Zeiss Ultra Prime lens. Set the focal length to exactly 14 mm and the aperture to exactly f/2.8; make the resulting field of view, perspective compression, and depth of field clearly visible while keeping the main subject centered.
